items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying, Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
items.claim: The LORD commanded that Israelite men should organize their camp by pitching with their father's house ensign, positioned far from the tabernacle.
items.actor: every man of the children of Israel
items.mechanism: by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house
